title: Hosted example inputs
description: The one typed funnel of the hosted example (spec 012 FR-003). Every value is declared here once; inner modules take required parameters and carry no defaults. Public copies of this file hold synthetic values only; the operator's real inputs, state, plans and evidence stay outside the repository.

version.description: The schema version this file is written against.

contract.description: The infrastructure owner's versioned output contract, consumed as inputs; no state is read across the boundary.

billing_account_reference.description: An opaque reference the infrastructure owner resolves; the public example holds a synthetic value.

digest.description: The content digest spec 009's verifier recorded; the deployment refuses any other and never rebuilds.

port.description: The container port; the server reads PORT and binds 0.0.0.0 in production.

allowed_origin.description: One exact origin, no path, no wildcard.

statement.description: What survives a revision change, in words the evidence repeats; a one-instance limit is never a durability claim.

endpoint.description: The OTLP/HTTP collector's exact origin, no path, on an external host in ASCII: a loopback, unspecified, link-local, multicast, private or zoned host is refused, since no collector is declared beside the service and the service declares no network of its own. The exporter sends no credentials, so this collector accepts the export without them.

sample_ratio.description: The share of traces kept; zero is valid and keeps none. A cost and volume choice, never a cap.

base_path.description: The path the static site is served under; a project site has one.

rpc_base_url.description: The backend's origin, independent of the base path.

budget_alert_amount.description: An alert threshold, never a cap: the evidence says so.

serving_digest.description: The digest to serve. A rollback sets it to previous_digest, which changes the digest and the revision reported for it (BFF_RELEASE_REVISION), and no other service setting.

previous_revision.description: The source revision previous_digest was built from, reported as BFF_RELEASE_REVISION when a rollback serves that digest; given exactly when previous_digest is.

cancel_in_flight.description: When true, an in-flight deployment is cancelled and the previous revision keeps serving.
